# ExcelJS 4.4.0

Browser bundle for XLSX exports with text wrapping and styles.
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/exceljs@4.4.0/dist/exceljs.min.js
Documentation: https://github.com/exceljs/exceljs
License: MIT (see ExcelJS-LICENSE.txt).

# jsPDF 4.2.1 and jsPDF-AutoTable 5.0.8

Local browser libraries for direct PDF downloads, without the print dialog.
Sources:
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf@4.2.1/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf-autotable@5.0.8/dist/jspdf.plugin.autotable.mjs

The AutoTable ES module is stored as `.js` for local-server MIME compatibility.
Documentation: https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF and https://github.com/simonbengtsson/jsPDF-AutoTable
Licenses: MIT (see jsPDF-LICENSE.txt and jsPDF-AutoTable-LICENSE.txt).

# Noto Sans

Regular and Bold TrueType fonts embedded as base64 in `noto-sans-fonts.js` for accented employee names in PDFs.
Source: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/tree/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSans
License: SIL Open Font License (see NotoSans-LICENSE.txt).
